plan.notes: Source: Texas A&M University undergraduate catalog, 'Nursing - BSN, Traditional BSN Track' — official program-requirements text PDF (https://catalog.tamu.edu/undergraduate/nursing/bsn/bsn_programrequirementstext.pdf), also rendered at https://catalog.tamu.edu/undergraduate/nursing/bsn/. True program name per catalog: 'Nursing - BSN, Traditional BSN Track' (Bachelor of Science in Nursing, Traditional BSN Track). Catalog year 2026-2027 (the current non-archived catalog edition as of 2026-09-30; Texas A&M's current catalog). Transcription method: downloaded the official Acalog program-requirements-text PDF and transcribed the term-by-term 'Program Requirements' tables directly; course codes, titles, and credit hours copied verbatim from the PDF. Caveats: (1) The catalog does not publish per-course prerequisites in the plan grid; prereq arrays are left empty per pipeline convention. (2) Slots labeled 'American history', 'Communication', 'Mathematics', 'Creative arts', 'Government/Political science' are University Core Curriculum categories — any course from the catalog's University Core Curriculum list in that category satisfies them (catalog footnote 1). STAT 201 is recommended for the Mathematics slots but is not required. (3) The chemistry slot is one 4-credit option: CHEM 106 + CHEM 116, or CHEM 107 + CHEM 117, or CHEM 119, or CHEM 120. (4) Catalog footnotes 2/3 mark 'Nursing Science' courses (BIOL 319/320 options, NUTR 222, PBSI 225, math slots, micro choice) and note they may be taken at a community college but must be completed by the first day at the School of Nursing. Footnote 4: Texas common courses BIOL 2401 and BIOL 2402 satisfy BIOL 319/320. (5) Traditional BSN students must complete at least 59 credit hours of nursing prerequisite coursework (Years 1-2) before beginning upper-division nursing courses; BSN students must make a minimum grade of C in all courses; proficiency in a foreign language is required (two years of the same language in high school or college credit).
